message.content: Add an /auth router with an /oauth/callback route that exchanges the code for tokens. Wire it into src/router.ts.

content.text: Got it. Creating the auth router first, then wiring it into router.ts.

content.text: Added `POST /auth/logout` above the callback. Clears `req.session.tokens` and returns 204.
